title: Interior Design Studio – Dynamic Website
oneLiner: A custom Django website featuring dynamic project galleries, client authentication, and OTP-verified password recovery.
note: Built during internship as a learning replica of a commercial website; all images and logos are sample data.
description: Constructed a database-driven portfolio website for an interior design studio featuring dynamic project portfolios, architectural category filtering, and client consultation workflows.
Integrated full user authentication with session management, role verification, and a secure email OTP password reset mechanism.
Empowered studio administrators to upload high-resolution design photography, organize project metadata, and curate hero showcase collections directly through the Django admin.

items: Dynamic architectural project galleries with category filtering.
Secure user registration, authentication, and session persistence.
Time-sensitive OTP password recovery via Django email backend.
Categorized design tags and project one-liners.

challenges.title: Preventing Replay Attacks in OTP Password Recovery
challenges.body: Implemented server-side timestamp validation with single-use invalidation flags to protect user account recovery flows.
